While ITGA2B (Glanzmann thrombasthenia 1) is directly involved in platelet aggregation, the extracellular matrix it interacts with is a product of broader ECM remodeling processes. **How to falsify it:** Demonstration that genetic variants in TIMP3 do not affect extracellular matrix remodeling in ocular tissues, or that platelet aggregation is entirely independent of general extracellular matrix integrity. _(variant: rs12345678)_
